# CrescentEd

> AI-powered learning platform that teaches young entrepreneurs how to start, run, and grow a real business through personalized lessons, templates, and an AI mentor.

CrescentEd builds a custom curriculum based on each learner's goals and business idea, organized across 7 domains of entrepreneurship. Learners get an AI tutor, ready-to-use worksheet/template generators, and PDF exports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of CrescentEd, the 7-domain framework, and how the AI builds a personalized course.
- [Sign Up](/register): Create a free CrescentEd account.
- [Log In](/login): Access your dashboard, modules, and AI tutor.

## Optional

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Authenticated learner dashboard with progress and modules.
- [Tools](/tools): AI-powered worksheet and template generators.
